1.explanation:
1. We wrap our app in the Grommet container and choose a default themeMode ("light" in this example).
2. We render two Box containers side by side:
   - One with background="dark-1" containing a Select.  
   - One with background="light-1" containing an identical Select.
3. The Select on the dark background does not show its dropdown arrow (it’s effectively transparent against the dark-1 color), while the Select on the light background does.

This minimal example reproduces the issue of the Select arrow icon not being visible on dark backgrounds in Grommet v2.
1.bug_scenario: In a Grommet v2 application, when rendering a Select component on a dark background (for example inside a Box with background="dark-1"), the dropdown arrow icon is not visible because its default color is too light/transparent to show up against the dark background. On a light background (e.g. "light-1"), the arrow appears correctly.
